verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a raw REST Public API: an Enterprise-only, API-key-authenticated /v1 endpoint, described in a single prose help-center article. It mentions no official SDKs or client libraries, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published from which one could be generated. A bare HTTP API is a developer building block, not the SDK capability the story asks for, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
